description: Convert a list of XML records to CSV (repeating sibling elements become rows; attributes become @columns), or convert a CSV with a header row back to XML. Optional comma, semicolon or tab delimiter, root and row element names, header row and UTF-8 BOM. DOCTYPE is rejected. Input is not stored.

bom.description: For to_csv, prepend a UTF-8 BOM

header.description: For to_csv, include a header row, default true

root.description: For to_xml, root element name, default records

row_element.description: For to_xml, row element name, default row

name: xml_to_csv
title: Convert XML to CSV, or CSV to XML
